parent: master6_actor_v1, full-precision f82bfd47 weights for both student and frozen anchor; evaluate parent and candidate as native int8
data: exact/manifest.json fixed before this experiment. Train only 800/801/322-325; physical holdout 326/327; 340 excluded.
fit: Draw evenly from the 12 fit branches, using only roots with an actual search-changed unit and both pair actions legal under the actual executed prefix. One fixed fit; no map, run or epoch selection. On these units optimize -logsigmoid((student_post-student_pre)-(parent_post-parent_pre)); on eligible untouched slots preserve the frozen parent's soft policy by KL with multiplier 3. No raw examiner logits or raw-teacher KL. Grad clip 1 AdamW weight decay 0.0001. Equal root updates across sources.
test: Load each frozen pack separately. On both predeclared held terrains, run the public entry from step zero on the entire archived trajectory, freely choosing its own within-turn prefixes. Record all live-unit outputs and the actual pre/post logit pair at that self-selected prefix. Strict primary: positive increase in proportion post>pre over their common support (both actions legal in BOTH parent and student); no decline in proportion choosing executed action outright on common support. Common-support coverage >=95% of pairs that were both legal at the archived prefix. Protection: agreement with unchanged recorded actions cannot fall by >2 percentage points on either map. Report all absolute actions, by map and seat. Parent is the deciding comparator. Paired branches share terrain; no game-strength claim.
responses: Only if all gates pass, select first root by tape/seat/time among two separate exposed terrains where a deployed joint action changes and parent-chosen unit equals native pre while student chooses native post. Use live opponent continuations and compare official terminal margin and observable economy before running new map. No training on response or final maps.
